name: Billing
description: Billing dashboard — check token balance, review spending history, manage subscription plan, view payment transactions, export usage reports for accounting.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_billing_status
tools.description: Background refresh: billing status for AI context.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get current token balance, plan name, and cap.

return_schema.description:
Single wallet/balance entity — the return shape of `get_balance`.

Existing keys kept verbatim: balance, plan, cap. Token balance is an integer
token count (NOT a money.amount currency value), so the Balanced money facet
is intentionally NOT mixed in — that would re-type `balance` to Decimal and
break int-reading panels.
return_schema.title: WalletBalance

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get subscription details: plan, status, billing period.

return_schema.description:
Single subscription entity — the return shape of `get_plan`.

Existing keys kept verbatim: plan, status, started_at, expires_at. The
Subscribable money facet is intentionally NOT mixed in: its
`subscription_status` is a strict Literal and its period fields are strict
`datetime`, either of which could reject the live billing values and break
construction. The free-form Entity `status` carries the plan status instead.
return_schema.title: PlanSubscription

tools.name: spending_report
tools.description: Show usage and spending breakdown by meter.

MeterUsage.description:
A single usage meter row — one item of `spending_report`.

Federal I-EXT-RECORD-FIELD-NAMING-SYMMETRIC: the field names mirror the REAL
keys the handler builds per meter from `LimitsResult` (verified vs
`ctx.billing.check_limits()` -> {plan, usage{meter:count}, limits{meter:n},
exceeded[meter]}). Each item carries the per-meter facts:
{meter, count, limit, exceeded}. id = title = meter.
MeterUsage.title: MeterUsage

return_schema.description:
`spending_report` return shape — a REAL sdl.EntityList[MeterUsage] whose
items are the per-meter usage rows, PLUS the plan-level scalars carried as
extra typed fields (EntityList is a pydantic BaseModel — additive allowed).

The handler returns:
    data={"items": [...meter dicts...], "total": <meter_count>,
          "plan": <str>, "exceeded": [<meter names...>]}
NO legacy {plan, usage{}, limits{}, exceeded[]} wrapper.
return_schema.title: SpendingReport

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Export transaction history as CSV.

return_schema.description:
`export_csv` return shape — a single CSV-artifact entity (kind='csvexport').

Field names mirror the REAL runtime keys verbatim (verified vs
handlers.fn_export_csv): {csv, filename, count}. id = filename; title =
filename; the row count is carried as `count`.
return_schema.title: CsvExport

tools.name: topup_status
tools.description: Check status of recent top-up payments.

TopupRecord.description:
A single top-up payment — one item of `topup_status`.

Federal I-EXT-RECORD-FIELD-NAMING-SYMMETRIC: field names mirror the REAL
transaction dict keys (verified vs queries.get_transaction_history rows):
{event_id, transaction_id, amount, reason, app_id, tool_name, description,
action_type, created_at}. id = event_id; title = the human top-up label.
TopupRecord.title: TopupRecord

return_schema.description:
`topup_status` return shape — a REAL sdl.EntityList[TopupRecord] whose
items are the recent top-up transactions.

The handler returns:
    data={"items": [...topup dicts...], "total": <count>}
NO legacy {payments:[dict]} wrapper.
return_schema.title: TopupStatusResponse

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the user's saved payment methods (credit/debit cards): brand, last 4 digits, expiry, and which is the default.

PaymentMethodCard.description:
One saved card. Fields mirror SDK PaymentMethod verbatim
(id/type/brand/last4/exp_month/exp_year/is_default).
PaymentMethodCard.title: PaymentMethodCard

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: List the user's payment history (subscriptions and token top-ups): amount, date, status, and a receipt link where available.

PaymentRecordEntry.description: One payment / invoice row. Fields mirror SDK PaymentRecord verbatim.
PaymentRecordEntry.title: PaymentRecordEntry

tools.name: change_plan
tools.description: Change the user's subscription to a different plan. Only Pro and Business are self-service (Free is reached by cancelling; Enterprise is by contract). The system charges a prorated upgrade immediately or schedules a downgrade for period-end automatically. Confirmation gate fires first.

return_schema.description: Result of upgrade_plan / downgrade_plan. Mirrors SDK ChangePlanResult.
return_schema.title: ChangePlanOutcome

tools.name: upgrade_plan
tools.description: Upgrade the user's subscription to a higher plan (Pro or Business — Enterprise is by contract). The prorated difference is charged immediately to the saved default card. Confirmation gate fires automatically; the user must confirm first.

return_schema.description: Result of upgrade_plan / downgrade_plan. Mirrors SDK ChangePlanResult.
return_schema.title: ChangePlanOutcome

tools.name: downgrade_plan
tools.description: Schedule a downgrade to a lower paid plan (Pro), effective at the end of the current period (no charge now; the user keeps what they paid for). To drop to Free, cancel the plan instead. Confirmation gate fires automatically; the user must confirm first.

return_schema.description: Result of upgrade_plan / downgrade_plan. Mirrors SDK ChangePlanResult.
return_schema.title: ChangePlanOutcome

tools.name: remove_payment_method
tools.description: Remove a saved card. Blocked by the server if it is the only card on an active paid plan. Confirmation gate fires automatically.

pm_id.description: Stripe payment-method id of the card to remove.
pm_id.title: Pm Id

tools.name: set_default_payment_method
tools.description: Set a saved card as the default for renewals and charges. Confirmation gate fires automatically; the user must confirm first.

pm_id.description: Stripe payment-method id of the card to remove.
pm_id.title: Pm Id

tools.name: buy_tokens
tools.description: Buy more tokens. Charges the prorated price to the saved default card. Confirmation gate fires automatically; the user must confirm first.

return_schema.description: Result of buy_tokens. Mirrors SDK TopupResult (off-session).
return_schema.title: TokenPurchaseOutcome

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List the subscription plans the user can choose from, with prices and what each includes.

tools.name: get_auto_topup
tools.description: Show the user's automatic top-up settings (whether it is on, the low-balance threshold, and the recharge amount).

tools.name: open_billing_portal
tools.description: Get a secure link to the Stripe billing portal where the user can add/remove cards, set a default, and download invoices.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel the user's paid subscription. It stays active until the end of the current billing period (no further charges). Confirmation gate fires automatically.

tools.name: resume_subscription
tools.description: Undo a scheduled cancellation — keep the subscription active. Confirmation gate fires automatically.

return_schema.description: Result of resume_subscription (undo a scheduled cancellation).
return_schema.title: ResumeOutcome

tools.name: set_auto_topup
tools.description: Turn automatic token top-up on/off and set the low-balance threshold and recharge amount. Confirmation gate fires automatically.

enabled.description: Turn auto top-up on or off.
enabled.title: Enabled

threshold_pct.description: Recharge when balance drops below this percent of cap.
threshold_pct.title: Threshold Pct

recharge_tokens.description: How many tokens to add on each recharge.
recharge_tokens.title: Recharge Tokens

payment_method_id.description: Card to charge (optional; defaults to the default card).
payment_method_id.title: Payment Method Id

tools.name: update_billing_profile
tools.description: Update the user's billing/VAT profile (name, company, VAT/GST number, country). Confirmation gate fires automatically.
